definition: a small rubber thing that removes pencil marks
description: A girl excitedly shows a little Mount Fuji eraser in its Japanese box, then rubs out pencil scribbles on lined paper, leaving a pile of grey shavings. As she uses it the blue eraser wears into a snow-capped mountain shape and she holds up the tiny Fuji proudly.
transcript: Look at my cute eraser. I use the eraser and the eraser becomes a little mountain. So pretty.

en.question: What does the eraser look like?
